claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-86950 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-09-29, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-10-02.
CVE-2026-86950 is rated 8.8 (high) under CVSS 3.1 by CISA in the CVE record.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-86950 being exploited in the next 30 days at 1.2%.

events.title: New Attack Against RSA
events.summary: ArsTechnica is reporting on a “new” attack against RSA, one that bypasses factoring. First, this attack isn’t new. The original research is from 2007 . What is new is the implementation. Second, it is a forgery attack. It allows an attacker to forge digital signatures. It does not recover the private key from the public key. Third, the attack only works against pure signatures. That is, signatures without any formatting or padding. This is not generally how we use RSA in practice. Fourth, speed is all relative. This is not a polynomial-time algorithm; it’s a subexponential-time algorithm. But…
